import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import norm
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(length):
    MU = 0
    SIGMA = 1

    distribution = np.random.normal(loc=MU, scale=SIGMA, size=length)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.hist(distribution, bins="auto", density=True, alpha=0.6, color="C0", edgecolor="black")

    x_min = distribution.min() - 3 * SIGMA
    x_max = distribution.max() + 3 * SIGMA
    x = np.linspace(x_min, x_max, 400)
    ax.plot(x, norm.pdf(x, MU, SIGMA), color="C1", linewidth=2)

    ax.set_title("Normal Distribution and Probability Density Function")
    ax.set_xlabel("Value")
    ax.set_ylabel("Density")

    return distribution, ax
